Priya B: Field asks consolidated: dry-run for BGP/route changes + signed offline bundles + clear upgrade choreography for on-prem. Need acceptance criteria and pilot plan.
Noah L: Dry-run = compute announcements + local validation vs customer-reported topology, no actual adverts. Provide a risk score (low/med/high).
Ibrahim K: Three upgrade modes: canary, rolling, fenced (control-plane migration). Dry-run should be available during canary step.
Priya B: Acceptance criteria (short): [signed bundle verifiable offline], [preflight_v1 passes], [dry-run produces route diff + risk score], [rollback documented & tested in lab].
devex-bot: build/redwood-check preflight v0.2 queued :gear:
Noah L: Sample preflight_v1 output (single-line JSON for support):
`{"schema":"preflight_v1","agent_version":"3.1.0","network_checks":"bgp:ok,egress:warn,firewall:missing(10250)","dry_run":"enabled","issues":"egress_ip_changed"}`
Ibrahim K: Agent config snippet to preserve egress + dry-run: `network: { egress_mode: preserve_ip, bgp: { enabled: true, asn:65012, neighbors:[10.0.0.1] }, dry_run: true }`
Priya B: Devex: redwood-check should support `--offline` and `--format=json`. Docs: handshake contract (ASNs, ports, MTU), preflight schema, rollback playbook.
Noah L: Pilot plan: 2 customers (simple NAT, full BGP fabric). Timeline: alpha in 4w, pilot 6-8w.
Priya B: Action items: (1) Noah dry-run risk heuristic (2) Ibrahim choreo + rollback triggers (3) devex build preflight alpha. Reconvene after PRs.
Noah L: Will prototype simulate mode that emits BGP payloads for change requests.
